title: Word Formation: The Age of Great Explorers (poziom rejonowy/wojewodzki)

tasks.instruction: Przeczytaj ponizszy tekst. Uzupelnij kazda luke (1.1-1.8), przeksztalcajac wyraz podany w ramce w taka forme, ktora logicznie i gramatycznie pasuje do kontekstu. Wymagana jest calkowita poprawnosc gramatyczna i ortograficzna wpisywanych wyrazow. Dwa wyrazy zostaly podane dodatkowo i nie pasuja do zadnej luki.
tasks.text: 1.1. _________ for their bravery, the great seafarers of the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries set out to chart unknown waters. Their 1.2. _________ completely changed how Europeans understood the world. These 1.3. _________ men and women were willing to risk everything for the chance of glory. Skilled 1.4. _________ used the stars and simple instruments to find their way across vast, empty seas. Many voyages were extremely 1.5. _________, and storms or disease could destroy an entire crew. Those who returned 1.6. _________ were rewarded with riches and honour by their rulers. Today, 1.7. _________ such as Columbus and Magellan are still remembered in books and films. Yet the less 1.8. _________ sailors, whose ships were lost at sea, are rarely mentioned at all.
